scope: Proposition 4.1 (Uniform approximately invariant unitaries) of the manuscript “Equivariant Jiang–Su Stability for Amenable Actions in the Unital Stably Finite Case” (preprints/Equivariant-Jiang-Su-Stability-for-Amenable-Actions-in-the-Unital-Stably-Finite-Case-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 291 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 99c6295ef166983a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite set H ⊂ G, every ε > 0, and every integer m ≥ 1, there are t > 0 and a self-adjoint element Q ∈ C such that V = exp(itQ) satisfies sup φ∈T(C) ∥ᾱh(V ) − V ∥2,φ < ε (h ∈ H), (4.1) sup φ∈T(C) |φ(V ℓ )| < ε (1 ≤ ℓ ≤ m). (4.2)
